answer: Make identity a reef, not a velvet curtain. A seat must hold a live Lightning channel with real balance, weight scaling with locked capacity times channel age, every open and close visible in gossip. Ten thousand puppets means ten thousand channels funded at once, capital the operator cannot reuse across addresses, and closing early forfeits the age premium, so the farm pays to stay and pays to leave. Cheap violet dye fades; the real thing was worth its weight in silver. Age is the one thing you cannot buy back.
